articles.title: Crypto investment firm Keyrock is acquiring bankrupt lender Blockfills
articles.snippet: The Brussels-based digital asset services firm plans to purchase BlockFills months after the Chicago-based company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, if a court approves.

articles.title: Crypto funds suffer second-largest outflows of 2026 while XRP and HYPE attract inflows
articles.snippet: Investors pulled $1.67 billion from digital asset investment products last week, with bitcoin funds posting their largest weekly outflow of the year, according to a recent report from CoinShares.

articles.title: Saylor's Strategy sold bitcoin for the first time since 2022. These firms are still buying
articles.snippet: With Strategy breaking its accumulation streak and many peers stepping aside, the list of active digital asset treasuries has narrowed considerably.

articles.title: It's not 2022 anymore: What Strategy's first bitcoin sale can (and can't) tell us about this one
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor's Strategy has evolved into a far more complex bitcoin-finance machine since it last sold BTC three and half years ago.

articles.title: Ethereum's Vitalik Buterin is rethinking how DeFi handles market crashes
articles.snippet: In a research post published Monday, Buterin proposed creating index-tracking assets using options contracts rather than the debt-based structures that underpin much of DeFi today.
